name: Gianna Ambrossi
source:
Gianna was born in New York on November 17th, 2003. Daughter of a widowed father, Gianna spent most of her early life attached to her father and grew extremely fond of him as she matured. When her father remarried, Gianna not only paid for the entire wedding, but also the honeymoon. She is a world renowned singer and actress, she is mostly known for her role in 007 Velvet Strike. Admittedly, she hates that role. Gianna also has a master in Psychology, with her ultimately wanting to become a therapist for children.
